svg.title: AI Agent — DevOps Lifecycle Control v2
svg.desc: Architecture diagram: Watchdog monitors deployment machine and target process; App Logs, Metrics and CI/CD feed the Event Bus; four AI agents process events with RAG context; outputs are alerts, dashboard and auto-rollback.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the Deployment Machine component?')
sendPrompt('What are App Logs in this system?')
sendPrompt('What are build artifacts and packages in this pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does the Watchdog monitor and how does it work?')
sendPrompt('How does the Event Bus work with Redis Streams?')
sendPrompt('What does the Metrics Agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Deploy Agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Correlation Agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Orchestrator Agent do?')
sendPrompt('What is the Vector DB used for in this system?')
sendPrompt('How does the alert system work?')
sendPrompt('What metrics appear on the dashboard?')
